description: Frontend features: Biomarker Trend Timeline (in MedicalVault.jsx), Explainable Risk panel (in PatientDashboard.jsx and GuestDashboard.jsx), and What-If Risk Simulator (in PatientDashboard.jsx and GuestDashboard.jsx). Depends on FEAT-001 for the new backend endpoints. These three frontend features all touch the dashboard result panel and MedicalVault, so they ship together to avoid conflicting edits to the same files.
steps:
2. In frontend/src/pages/dashboard/PatientDashboard.jsx and GuestDashboard.jsx, add Explainable Risk panel: a. Add state: `const [showFactors, setShowFactors] = useState(false);` and `const [resultFactors, setResultFactors] = useState([]);` b. In executeApiCall, after `setResult(response.data)`, also `setResultFactors(response.data.factors || []);` and `setShowFactors(false);` c. In the result display section (search for where `result.risk_score` is rendered), add after the risk score display: ```jsx {resultFactors.length > 0 && (
{showFactors && (
Key Risk Factors
{resultFactors.slice(0, 5).map((f, i) => (
{f.feature} Value: {f.value}
))}

These factors influenced the machine learning model's estimate. They do not establish medical causation or constitute a diagnosis.

)}
)} ``` d. Also reset showFactors and resultFactors in resetPredictor() and handleDiseaseSelect().
acceptance_criteria: MedicalVault renders 'Biomarker Trend Timeline' section with dropdown when archive has 2+ pathology records with same biomarker
SVG line chart renders dots and polyline with at least 2 data points
Status badge shows 'Improving' for glucose decrease, 'Worsening' for glucose increase, 'Changed' for ambiguous biomarkers
After prediction, 'Why this score?' button appears when factors array is non-empty
Factors panel shows top 5 factors with horizontal progress bars proportional to importance
Simulator panel shows current vs simulated estimate and difference in pp after Recalculate
Simulate calls POST /api/predictions/simulate/ — does NOT call /api/predictions/predict/
cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build completes with 0 errors
